name: One-Time Grant Money to Soldiers Conferred with Vishisht Seva Medal Award
benefit: - A one-time grant ranging from a minimum of ₹75,000/- to a maximum of ₹2,00,000/- is given to serving soldiers and ex-servicemen of the state.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a serving soldier or an ex-serviceman of the state who has been conferred with the 'Vishisht Seva Medal Award'.
